entries.text: Every TPC-DI entry point now refuses with "TPC-DI is unavailable while BenchBox reworks it to run the specification's workload (historical load, two incremental updates, automated audit). Earlier BenchBox TPC-DI results were withdrawn." and benchbox run, benchbox datagen and --dry-run exit 2; --official with TPC-DI is refused too.
details: The refusal covers benchbox run (including --dry-run and --official), benchbox datagen, the MCP run_benchmark, start_benchmark and get_query_details tools, the benchbox.TPCDI facade and the public methods of TPCDIBenchmark. The registry lists tpcdi as document_only with 0 queries, and the MCP discovery tools report it as unavailable with no queries.
A TPC-DI result that carries no TPC-DI audit block is recorded as NOT_VALIDATED and cannot be published or submitted.
Old TPC-DI result files still load read-only; they show "Legacy TPC-DI result from a withdrawn workload; not validated." and benchbox compare, benchbox publish and benchbox submit refuse them.
The TPC-DI tests of the old run path are deleted, and the release UAT matrix skips benchmarks whose registry status is document_only.
